description: Explicit /okay-reflect invocation after a delivered task
expectations: okay-reflect runs

description: Chinese request for a retro on the task just finished
prompt: PR 已经开了，复盘一下这次任务
expectations: okay-reflect runs

description: Stop hook reason asking for reflection
prompt:
An okay-* task was delivered but not reflected on (/repo/.git/okay-reflect-pending):
2026-10-31T10:00:00Z	okay-fix	fix slugify double dash
Run the okay-reflect skill now. Transcript: /home/u/.claude/projects/repo/abc.jsonl.
expectations: okay-reflect runs

description: User accepts the session-start offer to reflect on queued tasks
prompt: Yes, reflect on the 2 unreflected okay tasks from yesterday
expectations: okay-reflect runs

description: Reviewing a diff belongs to okay-review
prompt: Review the diff on PR #42 against the spec and post findings
expectations: okay-reflect does not run

description: A bug report belongs to okay-fix
prompt: The CSV export always drops the last row. Can you fix it?
expectations: okay-reflect does not run

description: General question about git internals is not a reflection
prompt: What is the difference between git rev-parse --git-dir and --show-toplevel?
expectations: okay-reflect does not run

description: Clean session ends in no change and clears the marker
prompt: /okay-reflect (the session ran okay-fix: the repro went red then green as planned, review APPROVED on the first try, no other command failed and the user corrected nothing)
expectations: Reports the outcome as no change
Does not create or comment on any issue in TONiiV/okay-lessons
Deletes the okay-reflect-pending marker in the repo's git dir

description: Three read-only reviewers on the right models, then an opus synthesizer
prompt: /okay-reflect (the session ran okay-fix; the user corrected the agent: "you pushed without asking, the merge rule is not set")
expectations: Spawns judgment (opus), tooling (sonnet) and contrarian (opus) reviewers in parallel, each told it may not edit, commit, or post
No reviewer prompt contains the main agent's own account of what went wrong
Runs one opus synthesizer over the three outputs
The candidate quotes the user's correction as its evidence and is attributed to an okay-fix section

description: Evidence and attribution gates drop findings
prompt: /okay-reflect (a reviewer says okay-fix 'could be clearer about naming' without quoting any event, and another blames okay-perf, which never ran this session)
expectations: Drops the naming finding for missing evidence
Drops the okay-perf finding because okay-perf did not run
Files no issue for either

description: Environment failures are not skill defects
prompt: /okay-reflect (gh failed with HTTP 502 twice during the PR step, then succeeded on retry; nothing else went wrong)
expectations: Classifies the gh failure as environment
Files no candidate issue
Reports no change

prompt: /okay-reflect (okay-fix's commit had a Co-Authored-By trailer and the user corrected it; okay-fix says no trailers)
expectations: Proposes a mechanism (for example a commit-msg check or a test) instead of more prose
The candidate's fix kind is mechanism, not prose

description: First occurrence files a candidate only; the second promotes with diff plus regression prompt
prompt: /okay-reflect (okay-fix skipped grepping callers and the user had to point out a second broken call site; an open lesson:candidate issue for the same okay-fix section exists from a different session)
expectations: Lists open lesson:candidate issues with the skill:okay-fix label before filing
Adds the new occurrence as a comment on the existing issue instead of opening a duplicate
Shows the user an exact unified diff of okay-fix plus one new behavioural entry for skills/okay-fix/evals.json
The diff and the regression prompt contain no repo, company, person, host, or path names from the session
Waits for approval and opens no PR before the user approves

description: User rejects a promotion; no change is recorded
prompt: No, don't change okay-fix for that one.
expectations: Opens no PR in okay-skills
Labels the lesson issue lesson:rejected and closes it with the user's reason

prompt: /okay-reflect (the repo matches a pattern under ## Contributor repos in ~/.claude/okay.local.md; okay-fix ran and the user corrected the MR description sections)
expectations: Writes the lesson to local memory only
Makes no gh call to TONiiV/okay-lessons and opens no PR
Still clears the marker when done

description: Queued tasks from earlier sessions are handled and removed
prompt: Reflect on the queued okay tasks
expectations: Reads the queue file under ~/.okay (or OKAY_HOME) and uses each entry's transcript_path
Removes only the handled entries from the queue by session id
